Agent Name: WebServing_Expert
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The agent misinterpreted key clues and violated the armor constraints. They took “bear” to mean a Druid instead of a Hunter’s pet and interpreted “Metamorphosis” as Demon Hunter rather than Warlock (as used during the relevant era). Their final set included Paladin, Priest, Mage, Druid, Demon Hunter, which fails the “two plate wearers and two cloth wearers” requirement (it yields one plate, two cloth, two leather) and omits Warlock, the class that both fits the cloth count and explains Metamorphosis and fire DPS. This incorrect reasoning led to the wrong group composition.
